exercises.title: Steering and spatial awareness

vehicle.displayName: Ibishu Covet Student Driver (4-speed manual), FWD

environment.areaHint: BMP dirt arena (MAPS W2): the course is laid out from the venue's spawn, heading south-west across the open dirt (about 40 m of room needed ahead).

exercises.instructions: Drive through the gate, keep the cone on your left, and stop with the whole car inside the parking box. One stop, no reversing.
exercises.resetInstructions: Go to drill puts you at the start with the gate, cone and box laid out ahead. Mark start moves the course to where you are; Use venue start puts it back.
exercises.props: None: the gate, cone and parking box are drawn for you.

assessment.successDefinition: Through the 3 m gate and past the cone on the correct side without touching either, then stop once with the whole car inside the 6 x 3.2 m box, without reversing. Silver: inside the silver box (0.3 m smaller all round) in 14 s or less. Gold: inside the gold box (0.5 m smaller) in 10 s or less.

exercises.title: Clutch engagement and launches

vehicle.displayName: Ibishu Covet Student Driver (4-speed manual), FWD

environment.areaHint: BMP Gravel Track (MAPS W1): the course is laid out from the venue's spawn on the tarmac start line, with the 40 km/h gate 60 m down the straight. The run ends at the gate, so nobody has to stop on the straight's banked end.

exercises.instructions: Launch, shift 1→2 and be at 40 km/h or more through the 40 km/h gate. The run ends at the gate; then slow down and stop wherever you like. No stall, no long wheelspin.
exercises.resetInstructions: Go to drill puts you on the start line with the gate laid out ahead. Move course here re-lays it from where you are.
exercises.props: None: the gate is drawn for you. Manual gearbox; keep the same clutch assist settings between attempts.

assessment.successDefinition: Through the 40 km/h gate (60 m) at 40 km/h or more, having shifted 1→2: no stall, no shift hanging in neutral over 1 s, no wheelspin over 1 s, 0–40 km/h within 8 s of moving off. The run ends at the gate. Silver: 0–40 in 4.5 s, shift under 0.6 s, wheelspin under 0.5 s. Gold: 0–40 in 3.5 s, shift under 0.4 s, wheelspin under 0.25 s.
assessment.metricToRecord: Clean launches / 10 (and your best 0–40 km/h time)

exercises.title: Gear selection and downshifting

vehicle.displayName: Ibishu Covet Student Driver (4-speed manual), FWD

environment.areaHint: BMP dirt arena (MAPS W2), the long straight: the 60 km/h gate 70 m in, the stop box 155 m from the start, all on level dirt.

exercises.instructions: Accelerate through the gears to 60 km/h at the 60 km/h gate, then brake and downshift one gear at a time to 2nd, and stop in the stop box. No over-revving, no lockup, no stall.
exercises.resetInstructions: Go to drill puts you at the start of the arena's long straight with the gate and stop box laid out ahead. Move course here re-lays it from where you are.
exercises.props: None: the gate and stop box are drawn for you. Manual gearbox; watch the rev counter.

assessment.successDefinition: Through the 60 km/h gate (70 m) at 55-75 km/h in 3rd or higher, then downshift one gear at a time to 2nd while braking and stop inside the stop box (155 m): never above 6700 rpm (the limiter is 6500), no shift hanging in neutral over 1 s, no wheel locked over 0.5 s, no stall, no reversing. Silver: under 6300 rpm, shifts under 0.6 s, no lock over 0.3 s, inside the silver box (1 m smaller all round). Gold: under 6000 rpm, shifts under 0.4 s, no lock over 0.15 s, inside the gold box (1.5 m smaller).

exercises.title: Throttle modulation

vehicle.displayName: Ibishu Covet Student Driver (4-speed manual), FWD

environment.areaHint: BMP Gravel Track run-up (MAPS W1): the course is laid out from 120 m behind the start line: three gates 25 m apart from 30 m in. The run ends at gate 3, on the flat.

exercises.instructions: Bring the car to 30 km/h, then hold that speed through the three gates 25 m apart, without braking. The run ends at gate 3.
exercises.resetInstructions: Go to drill puts you on the run-up with the three gates laid out ahead. Move course here re-lays them from where you are.
exercises.props: None: the gates are drawn for you. Speedometer only; the build-up to the first gate is not graded.

assessment.successDefinition: Speed at each of the three gates between 27 and 33 km/h, no braking between the first and last gate, and no gate post touched. Silver: 28-32 km/h at every gate. Gold: 29-31 km/h.
assessment.metricToRecord: Runs with all three gates in band

exercises.title: Braking accuracy

vehicle.displayName: Ibishu Covet Student Driver (4-speed manual), FWD

environment.areaHint: BMP dirt arena (MAPS W2): the course is laid out from the venue's spawn: the stop line 60 m ahead, on flat dirt.

exercises.instructions: Reach 40 km/h, then brake once and stop with the front bumper just before the stop line (0-2 m). No wheel lock.
exercises.resetInstructions: Go to drill puts you in the arena with the stop line and its cones laid out ahead. Move course here re-lays it from where you are.
exercises.props: None: the line and its cones are drawn for you.

assessment.successDefinition: Reach 38 km/h, then stop with the front bumper 0-2 m before the line (measured from the car's own bumper), with no wheel locked over 0.2 s and no cone touched. Silver: 0-1 m, no lock over 0.15 s. Gold: 0-0.5 m, no lock over 0.1 s.

exercises.title: Vision and looking ahead

vehicle.displayName: Ibishu Covet Student Driver (4-speed manual), FWD

environment.areaHint: BMP Gravel Track (MAPS W1), start line ~(103, 165). Figure Eight Basics layout: call the next bend aloud before each apex.

exercises.instructions: Drive bends while speaking the *next* turn direction and apex marker aloud before current apex.
exercises.resetInstructions: Stationary 50 m before first bend; fix start direction.
exercises.props: Voice-record or self-score; course layout fixed, no visual eye-tracking assumed.

assessment.successDefinition: Name the following bend and its target before the first apex; complete both cleanly.

exercises.title: Basic racing lines

vehicle.displayName: Ibishu Covet Gravel Rally (6-speed manual), FWD

environment.areaHint: BMP Gravel Track downhill left (MAPS W1): 67 m approach into a 124° left, radius 32 m; the exit gate sits at the track-out.

exercises.instructions: Take the downhill left on the line you choose (try early, middle and late apexes) and drive through the 3 m exit gate at the track-out, as fast as you can keep all four wheels on the gravel.
exercises.resetInstructions: Go to drill puts you 67 m before the corner with the exit gate laid out. Move course here re-lays it from where you are.
exercises.props: None: the exit gate is drawn for you. Explore the three apex lines before your scored block.

assessment.successDefinition: Through the 3 m exit gate at 30 km/h or more without touching its posts, no more than one wheel off the gravel (for over 0.5 s), no spin, no contact. Silver: 40 km/h at the exit and all four wheels on the gravel. Gold: 48 km/h.
assessment.metricToRecord: Clean exits and exit speed at the gate

exercises.title: Apex and exit selection

vehicle.displayName: Ibishu Covet Gravel Rally (6-speed manual), FWD

environment.areaHint: BMP Gravel Track downhill left (MAPS W1): the same corner as A07, with a late-apex gate on the inside, the exit gate and a finish 27 m on.

exercises.instructions: Turn in late through the 3 m apex gate on the inside, then the 3 m exit gate at the track-out, and drive straight to the finish without steering corrections.
exercises.resetInstructions: Go to drill puts you 67 m before the corner with the apex gate, exit gate and finish laid out. Move course here re-lays them from where you are.
exercises.props: None: the gates are drawn for you.

assessment.successDefinition: Through the 3 m apex gate and the 3 m exit gate without touching any post, at least 25 km/h at the exit, at most one steering correction between the exit gate and the finish, no more than one wheel off the gravel, no spin. Silver: 38 km/h at the exit, no corrections, all four wheels on the gravel. Gold: 45 km/h.

exercises.title: Threshold braking

vehicle.displayName: Ibishu Covet Student Driver (4-speed manual), FWD

environment.areaHint: BMP dirt arena (MAPS W2), the long straight: 180 m of level dirt; the stop zone is 150 m from the start, all on dirt.

exercises.instructions: Reach 70 km/h on the run-up, then brake progressively at the grip limit and stop with the car's centre in the stop zone. No long lockups.
exercises.resetInstructions: Go to drill puts you at the start of the arena's long straight with the stop zone laid out ahead. Move course here re-lays it from where you are.
exercises.props: None: the stop zone is drawn for you. Keep any ABS settings unchanged.

assessment.successDefinition: Reach at least 65 km/h, then stop with the car's centre inside the 5 m x 6 m stop zone, with no wheel locked for more than 0.5 s and no reversing. Silver: inside the 3 m x 4 m zone, no lock over 0.3 s. Gold: inside the 1.5 m x 3 m zone, no lock over 0.2 s.

exercises.title: Wheel lockup recognition and correction

vehicle.displayName: Ibishu Covet Student Driver (4-speed manual), FWD

environment.areaHint: BMP dirt arena (MAPS W2), the long straight: 180 m of level dirt; a large stop area 130-170 m from the start, all on dirt.

exercises.instructions: Reach 55 km/h, brake hard enough to lock the wheels, release quickly to get them rolling again, and stop inside the stop area without spinning.
exercises.resetInstructions: Go to drill puts you at the start of the arena's long straight with the stop area laid out ahead. Move course here re-lays it from where you are.
exercises.props: Verify ABS is absent/disabled; if ABS cannot be removed use another non-ABS configuration.

assessment.successDefinition: From 55+ km/h, provoke a lockup (at least 0.2 s) and release it within 1 s, then stop inside the 40 m stop area without spinning, on the road. Silver: released within 0.7 s. Gold: within 0.5 s.

exercises.title: Stopping-distance estimation

vehicle.displayName: Ibishu Covet Student Driver (4-speed manual), FWD

environment.areaHint: BMP Gravel Track run-up (MAPS W1): start 120 m behind the start line; the straight is flat from 60 m before the line to 50 m past it, then cambers and banks, so stops belong between the line and about 45 m past it.

features: a tarmac and a gravel stretch

exercises.instructions: Before each run, estimate stopping spot, then brake from exactly 50 km/h; six runs per surface.
exercises.resetInstructions: Go to drill puts you 120 m behind the start line. Reach 50 km/h and brake so you stop on the flat, no more than about 45 m past the line.
exercises.props: Record separate pavement/gravel observations; surface runs need two saved positions.

assessment.successDefinition: Actual bumper stops within 3 m of your predicted stopping marker; no collision.

exercises.title: Trail braking

vehicle.displayName: Ibishu Covet Gravel Rally (6-speed manual), FWD

environment.areaHint: BMP Gravel Track downhill left (MAPS W1): brake marker on the approach, the apex gate on the inside at the geometric apex, the exit gate across the road.

exercises.instructions: Brake on the approach from the Brake marker, keep easing the brake off as you steer into the corner, and be fully off it by the apex gate. Then drive out through the exit.
exercises.resetInstructions: Go to drill puts you 67 m before the corner with the brake marker, apex gate and exit laid out. Move course here re-lays them from where you are.
exercises.props: None: the gates are drawn for you.

assessment.successDefinition: Brake from the marker and carry it into the turn-in for at least 0.4 s while steering, fully off by the 4 m apex gate, through the exit at 25 km/h or more, no wheel locked over 0.3 s, no more than one wheel off the gravel, no spin. Silver: 35 km/h at the exit, all four wheels on the gravel. Gold: 42 km/h.

exercises.title: Left-foot braking

vehicle.displayName: Ibishu Covet Gravel Rally (6-speed manual), FWD

environment.areaHint: BMP dirt circle (MAPS W3), ~50 m infield ~(265, 40): a 15 m ring round its centre, driven anticlockwise.

exercises.instructions: Drive two laps of the ring anticlockwise. Keep your right foot on the throttle the whole way round, and dab the brake with your left foot to tighten the line whenever the car runs wide.
exercises.resetInstructions: Go to drill puts you on the ring facing the way round. Move course here lays the ring out from where you are, its centre 15 m to your left.
exercises.props: None: the ring and its corridors are drawn for you. A pedal overlay helps.

assessment.successDefinition: Two anticlockwise laps of the 15 m ring inside the 6 m corridor (a moment outside is fine), throttle never off for more than 0.5 s, at least two left-foot brake applications made with the throttle on, no spin. Silver: 4 m corridor, three applications, throttle gaps under 0.3 s. Gold: 3 m corridor, four applications, both laps in 22 s.

exercises.title: Understeer recognition and correction

vehicle.displayName: Ibishu Covet Gravel Rally (6-speed manual), FWD

environment.areaHint: BMP dirt circle (MAPS W3), ~50 m infield ~(265, 40): a straight approach into a left-hand half of a 15 m ring.

exercises.instructions: Arrive at the Turn in gate too fast for the 15 m ring, so the front pushes wide of the line. Then ease off the throttle and unwind a little steering until the front grips again, and bring the car back onto the line before the Exit gate.
exercises.resetInstructions: Go to drill puts you 22 m before the Turn in gate, with the half circle laid out. Move course here re-lays it from where you are.
exercises.props: None: the line and gates are drawn for you, with plenty of dirt outside the circle to run wide on.

assessment.successDefinition: Turn in fast enough that the front pushes 1-5 m wide of the 15 m line before the Regain gate, then get back within 1.5 m of the line by the Exit gate, through all four gates without spinning. Silver: back within 1.5 m by the Regain gate. Gold: a 2-4 m push, back within 1 m by the Regain gate.

exercises.title: Oversteer recognition and correction

vehicle.displayName: Ibishu Covet Gravel Rally (6-speed manual), FWD

environment.areaHint: BMP dirt circle (MAPS W3), ~50 m infield ~(265, 40): a straight approach into a left-hand quarter of a 15 m ring, then an exit lane north across the infield.

exercises.instructions: Arrive at the Turn in gate at about 45 km/h. As you turn in, brake hard or lift off to make the rear step out, then countersteer to catch the slide, settle the car on steady throttle and drive straight down the exit lane with the steering unwound.
exercises.resetInstructions: Go to drill puts you 22 m before the Turn in gate, with the exit lane laid out. Move course here re-lays it from where you are.
exercises.props: None: the gates are drawn for you.

assessment.successDefinition: The rear steps out at least 8 degrees between the Turn in gate and the end of the exit lane, the car goes through both 7 m lane gates without spinning, no more than three steering corrections in the lane, and at the lane end the slide is over (4 degrees) and the steering unwound (within 45 degrees of straight). Silver: a 12 degree slide caught. Gold: 15 degrees, caught with no more than two corrections.

exercises.title: Longitudinal weight transfer

vehicle.displayName: Ibishu Covet Gravel Rally (6-speed manual), FWD

environment.areaHint: BMP Gravel Track (MAPS W1), start line ~(103, 165). Broad gravel bend.

exercises.instructions: Do 4 lift-only, 4 light-brake and 4 neutral-entry runs; compare rotation and exit line.
exercises.resetInstructions: Stationary 60 m before gravel turn, same approach speed.
exercises.props: Keep steering entry point identical; compare only input timing.

assessment.successDefinition: Complete entry and exit without cone strike/spin; identify which input increased front bite.

exercises.title: Lift-off oversteer

vehicle.displayName: Ibishu Covet Gravel Rally (6-speed manual), FWD

environment.areaHint: BMP Gravel Track downhill left (MAPS W1), the C02 corner: a Turn in gate where the straight ends, a road-wide Apex gate and a 6 m Exit gate. Downhill helps the lift load the front.

exercises.instructions: Brake on the straight to about 60 km/h, then turn in on light throttle. Lift off sharply just after the Turn in gate to load the front and let the rear rotate, no brake until the apex. Catch it and drive out through the Exit gate on steady throttle.
exercises.resetInstructions: Go to drill puts you 67 m before the Turn in gate, with the corner laid out. Move course here re-lays it from where you are.
exercises.props: None: the gates are drawn for you.

assessment.successDefinition: The rear steps out at least 6 degrees between the Turn in and Apex gates with no brake between them (the lift does it), through all three gates without touching a post, no handbrake, no spin, out of the Exit at 25 km/h or more. Silver: 10 degrees and 40 km/h. Gold: 14 degrees and 45 km/h.

rules.hint: carry more speed and lift sharply as you turn in
carry more speed and lift sharply as you turn in
carry more speed and lift sharply as you turn in

exercises.title: Brake-induced rotation

vehicle.displayName: Ibishu Covet Gravel Rally (6-speed manual), FWD

environment.areaHint: BMP Gravel Track downhill left (MAPS W1): a Turn in gate where the straight ends, a road-wide Apex gate and a 6 m Exit gate between two posts at the track-out.

exercises.instructions: Arrive at about 65 km/h. Turn in at the Turn in gate, then give the brake a short, firm pulse (about half a second) to load the front and swing the rear into the corner. Release, catch it on steady throttle and drive out through the Exit gate. No handbrake.
exercises.resetInstructions: Go to drill puts you 67 m before the Turn in gate, with the corner's gates laid out. Move course here re-lays them from where you are.
exercises.props: None: the gates are drawn for you.

assessment.successDefinition: The rear steps out at least 8 degrees between the Turn in and Apex gates, through all three gates without touching a post, no handbrake, no spin, out of the Exit at 25 km/h or more. Silver: 12 degrees and 40 km/h. Gold: 15 degrees and 45 km/h.

exercises.title: Throttle-induced oversteer

vehicle.displayName: Ibishu BX-Series — 200BX Type-LS (M), RWD

environment.areaHint: BMP dirt circle (MAPS W3), ~50 m infield ~(265, 40). Circle (parked: needs RWD/AWD).

exercises.instructions: Use small power pulses to provoke rear slip while turning; then reduce power to regain balance.
exercises.resetInstructions: Stationary 40 m before 20 m radius circle; low gear.
exercises.props: Use wide runoff; avoid measuring drifting angle without sensors.

assessment.successDefinition: Rear breaks traction briefly and is caught; no spin, opposite lock held <3 s.

exercises.parked: Needs RWD or rear-biased AWD (FWD can't oversteer under power).

exercises.title: Handbrake rotation

vehicle.displayName: Ibishu Covet Gravel Rally (6-speed manual), FWD

environment.areaHint: BMP dirt arena (MAPS W2), open dirt ~(337, 96), fenced: a hairpin laid out on the open dirt, turning left round a pivot cone and back out through an exit gate.

exercises.instructions: Approach at about 50 km/h and brake to about 40 before the Pivot cone. Turn in left with half lock, then pull the handbrake once, firmly, to swing the rear round the cone (keep it on your left). Release it and drive out through the Exit gate the way you came.
exercises.resetInstructions: Go to drill puts you 34 m before the Entry gate, with the hairpin laid out. Move course here re-lays it from where you are.
exercises.props: None: the cone and gates are drawn for you.

assessment.successDefinition: Round the Pivot cone on your left and out through the Exit gate, one handbrake pull, the rear swinging at least 20 degrees, no post or cone touched, no stall, no spin, out at 15 km/h or more. Silver: 25 degrees and 25 km/h out. Gold: 25 degrees and 32 km/h out.

rules.hint: turn in harder and pull the handbrake firmly to swing the rear round
turn in harder and pull the handbrake firmly to swing the rear round
turn in harder and pull the handbrake firmly to swing the rear round

exercises.title: Countersteering and recovery

vehicle.displayName: Ibishu BX-Series — 200BX Type-LS (M), RWD

environment.areaHint: BMP dirt arena (MAPS W2), open dirt ~(337, 96), fenced. Open dirt arc (parked: needs RWD/AWD).

exercises.instructions: Deliberately create mild rear-wheel slide, steer into slide, then unwind to straight exit.
exercises.resetInstructions: Stationary 50 m before arc, identical 30 km/h entry.
exercises.props: Replay steering input if uncertain; count only obvious rear slips.

assessment.successDefinition: No spin, opposite lock unwound by exit marker, final trajectory inside 3 m exit lane.

exercises.title: Maintaining a controlled slip angle

vehicle.displayName: Hirochi Sunburst — NGRC2 Gravel Rally (M), AWD

environment.areaHint: BMP dirt circle (MAPS W3), ~50 m infield ~(265, 40). Circle arc (parked: needs RWD/AWD).

exercises.instructions: Initiate moderate slide before apex; balance throttle/countersteer through a marked 20 m arc.
exercises.resetInstructions: Stationary 70 m before sweeper; fixed 40–50 km/h entry band.
exercises.props: Use side camera replay to judge duration; no need exact angle telemetry.

assessment.successDefinition: Continuous visible controlled rotation through arc, no spin or four-wheel off-course.

exercises.parked: Needs RWD or AWD (FWD can't hold a slide on throttle).

exercises.title: Lateral weight transfer

vehicle.displayName: Ibishu Covet Gravel Rally (6-speed manual), FWD

environment.areaHint: BMP dirt arena (MAPS W2), open dirt ~(337, 96), fenced: two cones 20 m apart side by side, 35 m ahead, with the crossing between them.

exercises.instructions: Drive up to the crossing between the cones, go clockwise round the right-hand cone, back through the crossing, anticlockwise round the left-hand cone and back through the crossing. Use lift and brake timing to swing the car from one lobe into the next.
exercises.resetInstructions: Go to drill puts you 35 m before the crossing, centred on it. Move course here re-lays the figure-eight from where you are.
exercises.props: None: the cones and gates are drawn for you.

assessment.successDefinition: Through the crossing, round the right-hand cone clockwise, back through the crossing, round the left-hand cone anticlockwise and back through the crossing (five gates in order), without touching a cone or post or spinning, in 30 s. Silver: 23 s. Gold: 21.5 s.

exercises.title: Scandinavian flicks

vehicle.displayName: Ibishu Covet Gravel Rally (6-speed manual), FWD

environment.areaHint: BMP Gravel Track downhill left (MAPS W1): a Flick gate 40 m into the approach, then the C02 corner gates (Turn in, a road-wide Apex, a 6 m Exit).

exercises.instructions: Arrive at about 60 km/h. After the Flick gate, lift and steer briefly away from the corner (right), then turn sharply in (left) in one movement, with a touch of brake as you turn in, so the rear swings into the corner. Catch it and pull out through the Exit gate on throttle. No handbrake.
exercises.resetInstructions: Go to drill puts you 40 m before the Flick gate, with the corner laid out. Move course here re-lays it from where you are.
exercises.props: None: the gates are drawn for you.

assessment.successDefinition: Between the Flick and Apex gates, steer at least 60 degrees away from the corner and then 60 degrees into it within 1.5 s, and the rear steps out at least 8 degrees; through all four gates without touching a post, no handbrake, no spin, out of the Exit at 25 km/h or more. Silver: 12 degrees and 40 km/h. Gold: 15 degrees and 45 km/h.

exercises.title: Slaloms and rapid transitions

vehicle.displayName: Ibishu Covet Gravel Rally (6-speed manual), FWD

environment.areaHint: BMP dirt arena (MAPS W2), open dirt ~(337, 96), fenced: six cones in a line 15 m apart from 25 m ahead, then a Finish gate.

exercises.instructions: Weave through the six cones: the first on your right (pass it on its left), then alternate. Keep the steering smooth and the car moving, and carry speed through the Finish gate.
exercises.resetInstructions: Go to drill puts you 25 m before the first cone. Move course here re-lays the slalom from where you are.
exercises.props: None: the cones and gate are drawn for you.

assessment.successDefinition: All six cones passed on the correct side without touching one, no spin, through the Finish gate at 25 km/h or more, in 18 s. Silver: 14.8 s. Gold: 13.8 s.

exercises.title: Linked-corner sequencing

vehicle.displayName: Ibishu Covet Gravel Rally (6-speed manual), FWD

environment.areaHint: BMP Gravel Track (MAPS W1), start line ~(103, 165). Two linked bends from one of the layouts.

exercises.instructions: Prioritize second bend exit even if first apex is compromised; compare with single-corner focus.
exercises.resetInstructions: Stationary 80 m before first bend; RSC start gate at vehicle reset.
exercises.props: Use Rally Stage Creator (RSC) 20–40 s custom section; create finish past bend two.

assessment.successDefinition: No contact/off-road, and timed segment within +8% of fastest clean attempt.

exercises.title: Decreasing-radius corners

vehicle.displayName: Ibishu Covet Gravel Rally (6-speed manual), FWD

environment.areaHint: Gravel lane DR825 west of the town (MAPS W6): a right-hander whose radius tightens from about 60 m to 18 m over a small crest. Entry, Apex (at the tightest point) and Exit gates.

exercises.instructions: Enter conservatively: the corner keeps tightening. Brake on the way in and keep easing speed off as the radius closes, turn in late and hold the apex at the tightest point, then drive out through the Exit gate. Never so fast that you have to stamp on the brake mid-corner or put two wheels off the gravel.
exercises.resetInstructions: Go to drill puts you at the start of the lane, 35 m before the bend. Move course here re-lays the gates from where you are.
exercises.props: None: the gates are drawn for you.

assessment.successDefinition: Through the Entry, Apex and Exit gates without touching a post, no more than one wheel off the gravel for 0.5 s, no contact, no spin, out of the Exit at 20 km/h or more. Silver: 28 km/h. Gold: 34 km/h.

exercises.title: Increasing-radius corners

vehicle.displayName: Ibishu Covet Gravel Rally (6-speed manual), FWD

environment.areaHint: Gravel lane DR825 west of the town (MAPS W6), uphill: a 19 m left-hander that opens steadily onto a straight. Apex, Opening and Exit gates.

exercises.instructions: Enter the left-hander at a safe speed, then from the apex unwind the steering and feed the throttle in progressively as the corner opens, without spinning the front wheels, and drive out through the Exit gate.
exercises.resetInstructions: Go to drill puts you 15 m before the bend. Move course here re-lays the gates from where you are.
exercises.props: None: the gates are drawn for you.

assessment.successDefinition: Through the Apex, Opening and Exit gates without touching a post, a third of the throttle or more for 1 s after the apex, no front wheel spinning for more than 0.5 s after the apex, no more than one wheel off the gravel, no contact, no spin, out of the Exit at 25 km/h or more. Silver: 45 km/h. Gold: 52 km/h.

exercises.title: Blind corners

vehicle.displayName: Ibishu Covet Gravel Rally (6-speed manual), FWD

environment.areaHint: Off-Road Circuit (MAPS W5), the north straight into a left hairpin that turns 180 degrees across a crest: the exit drops away out of sight. Turn in, Crest and Exit gates.

features: blind: hidden by a crest, heap or trees

exercises.instructions: Arrive at the Turn in gate at a steady, conservative speed (35-40 km/h is ideal) that would let you stop or tighten the line if the road beyond the crest isn't what you expect. Drive the hairpin from the cockpit, reading the walls and the crest, and out through the Exit gate.
exercises.resetInstructions: Go to drill puts you 85 m before the Turn in gate. Move course here re-lays the gates from where you are.
exercises.props: None: the gates are drawn for you.

assessment.successDefinition: 30-45 km/h at the Turn in gate, through the Crest and Exit gates without touching a post or the walls, no spin. Silver: 33-42 km/h. Gold: 35-40 km/h.

exercises.title: Uphill and downhill corners

vehicle.displayName: Ibishu Covet Gravel Rally (6-speed manual), FWD

environment.areaHint: Off-Road Circuit (MAPS W5) from its start: an uphill right-hander (9-14 %), over the crest, then a 7 % descent into a downhill left-hander. Uphill, Downhill and Exit gates.

exercises.instructions: Drive from the start through the uphill right-hander (carry speed, pick the gear before the slope), over the crest and down the descent.
